title: ChargePoint Rings the Opening Bell at the New York Stock Exchange
body_markdown:
**NEW YORK, September 22, 2026** — This morning,[ChargePoint](https://www.chargepoint.com/) Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: CHPT) rang the Opening Bell at the New York Stock Exchange on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, a milestone moment for the global leader in intelligent electrification. The ceremony brought together company leadership, employees, and partners to mark both a symbolic turning point and a period of accelerating commercial momentum.


The occasion underscored what ChargePoint's leadership described as a decisive convergence: nearly two decades of infrastructure investment, a maturing EV market, and the emergence of AI-driven fleet and energy management are arriving at the same moment.


"Ringing the Opening Bell is a powerful moment to recognize how far ChargePoint has come — and, more importantly, where we're going next. The convergence of energy, mobility, and AI is creating entirely new opportunities across autonomous vehicles, electrified fleets, transit, and high-speed charging. ChargePoint has spent nearly two decades building the intelligent electrification platform to power that future, and we're just getting started," said Mansi Khetani, Chief Executive Officer, ChargePoint.


**Second Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights**


ChargePoint's second quarter results reflected the company's sharpened focus on disciplined growth. Revenue grew 18% year-over-year, while gross margins reached a record high for the company as a public entity. Perhaps most significantly, the company achieved effectively zero cash burn during the quarter, without compromising execution or the scope of its business.


**Positioned at the Center of Intelligent Electrification**


ChargePoint pointed to several growth vectors it believes are still in early stages: autonomous and semi-autonomous vehicle charging infrastructure, large-scale fleet electrification for commercial and government operators, intelligent energy management that connects vehicles to grid services, and the build-out of high-speed charging corridors. Across each of these, ChargePoint's software-first, hardware-agnostic platform is positioned to play an integrating role.


The NYSE bell-ringing also carried symbolic weight for a company that has navigated a challenging period for the broader EV sector. ChargePoint's return to the NYSE floor — on its own terms, with improving fundamentals — was a statement about the durability of its business model and the strength of the team that has carried it through.


ChargePoint is the intelligent electrification platform where energy, mobility, and AI converge to power the electric economy. The company's industry-leading full stack intelligent electrification platform will continue to drive growth going forward.
